name: Washington

windshield.strip: transparent product along the top edge allowed if it does not extend into the AS-1 portion or more than 6 in. from the top; clear UV-reducing film allowed on the windshield

frontSide.note: net film sunscreening (factory tint + film) min 24% light transmission, max 35% reflectance; outside mirrors both sides required; only a single sheet of film per window

backSide.note: same 24% / 35% reflectance rule; mirrors both sides

rear.note: same 24% / 35% reflectance rule; mirrors both sides

windshield.strip: same as passenger (AS-1 or 6 in. from top)

backSide.note: vehicles identified by the manufacturer as truck, motor home or multipurpose passenger vehicle may go below 24% on windows to the rear of the driver if reflectance max 35% and mirrors on both sides

tint.measuredHow: film + glass combined ('net film sunscreening' includes manufacturer shading and aftermarket film)
tint.dualMirrors: When film is applied to any window except the windshield, outside mirrors on both left and right sides giving a 200-ft rear view are required
tint.certificateOrSticker: Commercial installer tinting restricted areas must affix a sticker on the driver's door post (between 3/4 x 1.5 in. and 2 x 2.5 in.) with business name and state tax ID, certifying compliance

medicalExemption.text: Greater light reduction on all windows and the top 6 in. of the windshield for a vehicle operated by or carrying a person with written verification from a licensed physician that they must be protected from sunlight; no state permit, keep the physician's verification

penalty.text: Operating with illegal film: traffic infraction. Knowingly installing illegal film: misdemeanor; buying/selling illegal installation services: gross misdemeanor. Mirror-finish, liquid spray-on film also prohibited.

quotes: The maximum level of net film sunscreening to be applied to any window, except the windshield, shall have a total reflectance of thirty-five percent or less, and a light transmission of twenty-four percent or more

any vehicle identified by the manufacturer as a truck, motor home, or multipurpose passenger vehicle ... may have net film sunscreening applied on any window to the rear of the driver that has less than twenty-four percent light transmittance
does not extend into the AS-1 portion of the windshield or extend more than six inches from the top of the windshield
Mirror finish products; (ii) Red, gold, yellow, or black material

helmet.conditions: All operators and riders of motorcycles, motor-driven cycles and mopeds (except enclosed vehicles with steering wheel and seat belts, antique motor-driven cycles)

handheldPhone.fineText: Traffic infraction, base penalty under RCW 46.63.110(3); second or subsequent offense doubled; doubled in crash prevention zones (amended 2026 c 123)

studdedTires.season: Nov 1 - Apr 1 (unlawful between April 1 and November 1; retractable studs engaged only Nov 1 - Apr 1)

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

liftHeight.rule: No numeric lift limit found in RCW; factory bumpers/energy-absorbing systems must be maintained and not removed

openQuestions: Exact phone fine amount (RCW 46.63.110 / court rule base penalty) not read
WAC 204-21 (State Patrol film rules) not read
Underglow rule not located; lift/frame height rules in WAC not read
